findings.title: Circular test oracles misrepresent pricing coverage
findings.description: Line 6 compares the actual result to its alias; line 11 calls the subject again for the expected value; lines 17–18 copy the production calculation as the oracle. A deterministic finalPrice returning 0 passes the first two; an incorrect tax rule copied into production and the oracle passes the third. Consolidate the circular-oracle findings and replace them with independent expected prices.
